rationale: The instrument shows essentially no price discovery — all five 1-minute candles are identical doji at $36.66 with only 6,320 shares traded (0.21x relative volume), meaning there is no directional momentum or structure to trade against. The bid-ask spread of ~221 bps creates an immediate and severe cost disadvantage that would require a large move just to break even. With the broader market under mild pressure (SPY -0.70%, VIXY +2.95%) but no actionable setup in this illiquid name, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
